rooms.name: Newton's Chambers (Trinity College)
rooms.description: Your private first-floor rooms above the walled garden. Manuscripts crowd every surface — optical treatises beside alchemical transcriptions. Through the window, chimney smoke rises from the furnaces below. The Work calls.

rooms.name: Walled Garden Path
rooms.description: A narrow path between herb beds and the chapel wall. Coal smoke and distillates hang in the cool Cambridge air. The laboratory door stands slightly ajar.

rooms.name: The Chymical Laboratory
rooms.description: Your secret workshop in the garden below the chapel. Brick furnaces of your own design line the walls. Retorts bubble on sand-baths. Crucibles wait beside a silica garden jar where mineral forms grow like strange plants. This is where thirty years of chymistry unfold.
